# MAPPA

> > MAPPA is a leading Japanese animation studio producing acclaimed anime series and films including JUJUTSU KAISEN, Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan, and The Rose of Versailles.

MAPPA (Maruyama Animation Produce Project Association) operates multiple studio divisions in Tokyo, specializing in TV animation, anime movies, and CGI production. The studio has become renowned for high-quality adaptations of popular manga and original anime works.
